A graceful dragon glides silently over the city's spires, silhouetted against the glowing evening sky.
A great luminous moon hangs low behind the towers, vast and silver, doubling in the lake below.
A slow fall of golden leaves drifts down across the bridges and walkways, catching the light.
A flight of white swans sweeps low over the canopy, wings catching the last rose-gold sunlight.
A vivid aurora ripples in curtains of green and violet above the highest elven towers.
A cascade of cherry blossoms tumbles softly through the lamplit streets, swirling around slender columns.
An elven sailing ship glides serenely into the harbor, its white sails luminous against the dusk.
A single shaft of divine golden light breaks through the forest canopy, illuminating the central plaza.
A unicorn stands still in a moonlit garden below, its horn catching light like a pale flame.
A procession of lanterns winds slowly along the arching bridges, threading orange gold through the blue twilight.
A wide rainbow arcs over the waterfall, each color vivid and mirrored in the churning mist below.
A comet burns silently across the twilight sky, trailing silver fire above the tallest spire.
A second dragon, smaller and jade-green, banks lazily between two ivory towers in the amber dusk.
Hundreds of luminous fireflies rise from the gardens below, drifting upward like scattered living embers.
A flock of silver herons lifts from the canopy in perfect formation, climbing into the pale sky.
Twin moons hang together in the violet dusk, one large and gold, one small and blue.
A soft snowfall begins, draping every bridge and blossom in white silence under warm lantern glow.
A meteor shower scatters bright streaks across the deep indigo sky above the sleeping city.
An enormous silver owl glides between the towers, wings spread wide, eyes catching the moonlight.
A river of rose petals flows along the central canal, carried gently beneath the stone bridges.
A distant thunderstorm flickers with silent lightning far beyond the city, framing it in dramatic contrast.
A ribbon of bioluminescent mist rises from the river, winding blue-white through the lower walkways.
A second elven ship follows the first, lanterns strung from mast to bow, glowing warm amber.
A solar eclipse crowns the sky in a ring of fire just above the highest tower.
A great whale-shaped cloud drifts slowly overhead, backlit gold, casting a vast soft shadow across the city.
